verdict.rationale: Netlify offers serverless functions, so documented CPU and wall-clock execution limits are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack states any function timeout, CPU limit, or duration cap. The serverless-functions mention and the community billing complaints do not address execution-time limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
